description: The system groups as the formulas of a class see them (ADR-0052). INGROUP answers a system group as it answers any group, and answers everyone for every caller that has an id; a call without a principal is nobody and is in no group. A content administrator passes the rules of a class and never a guard. A designer, a database administrator and an analyst pass no rule by being one: they see and change what the formulas of the class give them.

access.read: owner = USER() OR INGROUP("analysts") OR INGROUP(circle)

script.name: everyone creates: Ann has an id, so she is in the group
a call without a principal is nobody, and nobody is not in everyone
Bob does not see Ann's memo
an analyst sees it, by the rule that names the system group
and finds it with a filter, where the name is decided before the statement
a designer sees it, by the group the memo itself names
and finds it with a filter, where the group is looked up among the caller's
a database administrator does not see a document by running the database
nor count it
nobody sees it
the designer may change it, by the group the memo names
the analyst sees it and may not change it
the designer may not send it: the rule of the transition names the owner
everyone in a where of Ann's own filter
a content administrator sees every memo
and changes one past the update rule
but never past a guard: nothing to send
with the guard holding, the content administrator sends it past the rule of the transition
the memo is sent
the owner may not delete, as the class says
the log says who did each step
